scope: Dinosaur exhibit institutional 3D scans, documented derivatives, and local fallback images
notes: CC BY-NC assets are used only for this educational exhibit and retain visible attribution.

Local GLB files are unmodified museum deliveries; remote Sketchfab viewers retain their source platform attribution.
